rates.ages.inherited: No bands in this version: the hotel/market pricing policy's bands are used when the version is published.
rates.ages.intro: Child age bands decide which child rule applies. Ages are compared in whole months on the arrival date.
rates.ages.invalid: The band must end after it starts.
rates.ages.strip: Age bands on an age scale
rates.basis_help.PERSON: a base person rate; each occupant pays a share set by the occupancy rules
rates.basis_help.ROOM: one price per room per night covering the included adults
rates.boards.desc_add: {board}: + {v} {ccy} per adult per night; children pay {child} % of that.
rates.boards.desc_base: {board} is included in the room price.
rates.boards.intro: The base board is included in the price. Other boards add a supplement per adult (children pay a share), a percentage, or a fixed amount per room.
rates.boards.no_base: No board is marked as included. Mark the board that the room price already includes.
rates.combine_help.REPLACE: Only the most specific matching REPLACE rule applies.
rates.combine_help.STACK: Applied on top of the winning REPLACE rule, and shown separately in the explanation.
rates.common.csv_hint_all: Tick the values that apply. Nothing ticked means: {all}.
rates.contract.details_live: Windows, channels, priority and sell currency of the live version.
rates.contract.duplicate_desc: Copies the header and the latest version into a new contract with a draft version. Nothing is published.
rates.contract.locked_body: A version of this contract has been published, so what it sells on is fixed. Market, currency and pricing basis never change: duplicate the contract to sell another market or currency. Sale and stay windows, channels, priority and sell currency belong to each version: change them in a new draft version (Settings → Selling terms) and publish it. Code, name, notes and the BAR flag stay editable.
rates.contract.new_desc: The header defines who the contract sells to and when. Prices go into its first draft version.
rates.contract.new_notice: An empty draft version (V1) is created with the contract. Nothing is sold until a version is published.
rates.contract.status_body.archive: The contract stops selling and is kept for history. Sold reservations keep their prices.
rates.contract.status_body.restore: The contract comes back suspended (as a draft if it was never published). Resume it to sell again.
rates.contract.status_body.resume: The contract sells again on its published versions.
rates.contract.status_body.suspend: New bookings stop at once. Published versions and sold reservations stay as they are; resume to sell again.
rates.contract.title: Contract
rates.contracts.caption: Contracts
rates.contracts.none_hint: Create a contract for a market (e.g. Germany Summer 2027), add rooms, periods and prices, then publish it.
rates.contracts.subtitle: Hotel contracts per market with versioned, published price terms.
rates.deposit_help.FIXED: A fixed deposit is charged at booking, in the policy's currency (the contract's when empty).
rates.deposit_help.FULL: The full amount is charged at booking.
rates.deposit_help.NIGHTS: The price of the first N nights is charged at booking.
rates.deposit_help.PERCENT: A share of the total is charged at booking.
rates.extra_mode_help.NIGHT: Each night of the stay, per room.
rates.extra_mode_help.PERSON: Each occupant; children and infants may have their own price.
rates.extra_mode_help.PERSON_NIGHT: Each occupant for each night (e.g. spa access).
rates.extra_mode_help.RESERVATION: Charged once per booking, however many rooms (e.g. airport transfer).
rates.extra_mode_help.ROOM: Charged once for each room booked.
rates.extra_mode_help.SERVICE_DATE: Each date the guest selects for the service.
rates.extra_mode_help.STAY: A flat amount per room stay, whatever the nights.
rates.extra_mode_help.USAGE: Each use, e.g. one spa session.
rates.extra_unit.PER_PERSON_SHARE: Per-person share of the room price
rates.f.children_over_max_as_adults: Children above the top age band pay as adults
rates.f.days_before_arrival: Cancelled less than … days before arrival
rates.f.label: Label
rates.fx.manual_hint: Stands in for the provider's reference rate while it is stale or missing (a bank holiday); each FX policy adds its own margin on top. Dated, audit-trailed, for one hotel or all.
rates.fx.none_hint: Fetch the provider's rates now or wait for the daily import.
rates.fx.read_only: Provider rates are shared by every hotel: only platform administrators fetch them. A manual rate for your hotel needs the permission to enter manual FX rates.
rates.fx.subtitle: Daily provider rates (TCMB, ECB) and the dated manual rates that bridge a gap in them.
rates.fx.title: FX rates
rates.fx_mode_help.MANUAL: Always this rate, regardless of provider feeds.
rates.fx_mode_help.PROVIDER: Uses the latest provider rate as is.
rates.fx_mode_help.PROVIDER_FIXED: Provider rate plus a fixed amount, e.g. 50 + 1.50 = 51.50.
rates.fx_mode_help.PROVIDER_PERCENT: Provider rate plus a margin, e.g. EURTRY 50 + 2 % = 51.
rates.h.adjustment_op: Optional night surcharge or discount for this period, e.g. +10 % on weekends.
rates.h.age_basis: The child's age is taken on the arrival date (standard) or on the booking date.
rates.h.allow_pay_at_hotel: The guest may settle the remaining balance on site.
rates.h.balance_due_days: When the rest of the stay must be paid, counted back from arrival.
rates.h.band_code: Short code used by occupancy rules, e.g. INF, CHA, CHB.
rates.h.base_room_type: The room whose price this one follows. Change the base and this room moves with it.
rates.h.based_on: The new draft starts as a copy of this version; published versions stay untouched.
rates.h.board_base: The base board is included in the room price; other boards add a supplement.
rates.h.bookable_after_booking: Guests can add it later from their booking page.
rates.h.change_note: What changed and why. Shown in the version history and the audit trail.
rates.h.change_note_draft: Summarise the change for colleagues; you can refine it when publishing.
rates.h.channels: Leave empty to sell on every channel.
rates.h.child_ordering: Child rules such as “2nd child 25 %” count children in this order.
rates.h.children_ages: Ages on arrival, 0–17. Infants and children are priced by the age bands.
rates.h.children_over_max_as_adults: E.g. a 14-year-old above a 0–12 band is priced as an extra adult.
rates.h.combination: Adults+children, e.g. 2+1, 1+0, 2+* (any children). Empty = any occupancy.
rates.h.compound: Calculated on the price plus the taxes listed before it.
rates.h.contract_code: Short unique code for this hotel, e.g. DE-S27.
rates.h.contract_currency: Currency of the net prices agreed in this contract.
rates.h.contract_priority: When several contracts can sell the same stay, the higher priority wins.
rates.h.contract_status: Only Active contracts sell. Suspended pauses sales without touching versions.
rates.h.coupon_code: Guests or agents type this code to get the discount.
rates.h.currency_fixed: Currency of fixed amounts; empty uses the contract currency.
rates.h.fixed_amount: A fixed amount is in the policy's currency; empty currency means the contract's.
rates.h.cutoff_days: The contract stops selling these nights this many days before arrival, even from general sale, and its unsold rooms go back to general sale then at the latest. 0 = no cutoff.
rates.h.daily_capacity: Units per day. A service-date extra uses each chosen date, a nightly one every night, a per-person one a unit per guest; the others use their chosen day (arrival by default).
rates.h.days_before_arrival: The penalty applies when the booking is cancelled fewer than this many days before arrival.
rates.h.duplicate_market: Choose another market to start, e.g., the UK contract from the German one.
rates.h.effective_from: Uses the server's time zone. Must be in the future.
rates.h.end_inclusive: The last night of the period is included.
rates.h.exclusive: When it applies, no other promotion is combined with it.
rates.h.extra_code: Short unique code, e.g. TRF for an airport transfer.
rates.h.extra_unit.PER_PERSON_SHARE: Extra adults/children are priced from the room price divided by the included adults.
rates.h.extra_unit.ROOM_PRICE: Extra adults/children are priced from the full room price.
rates.h.free_nights: E.g. stay 7, pay 6: the cheapest night is free.
rates.h.from_age: Inclusive, in years (3 = from the 3rd birthday).
rates.h.fx_adjustment: Percentage (provider-rate mode with %) or a fixed amount in the target currency added to the provider rate.
rates.h.guaranteed: Rooms are held for this contract until the release date, even if unsold.
rates.h.guest_text: Shown in the booking engine and confirmation.
rates.h.included_adults: Room basis only: how many adults the room price covers (0 = room type default).
rates.h.infants_count_as_occupants: If off, infants do not use a bed place when checking room capacity.
rates.h.infants_count_as_children: For combination rules (e.g. 2+1) and the room's maximum children. If off, infants are numbered after the other children and never change their price.
rates.h.inventory_tracked: Sell at most the daily capacity per day (e.g. spa slots). Stays already sold keep their units; see and change each day in Inventory → Extras. A mandatory extra cannot be limited.
rates.h.is_base: The base room carries absolute prices; other rooms can be derived from it.
rates.h.is_infant: Infants can be free on boards and do not always count as occupants.
rates.h.is_mandatory: Added to every booking automatically (e.g. gala dinner).
rates.h.is_override: Wins over every other rule for the same slot (highest precedence).
rates.h.locked_after_publish: Locked: a version of this contract has been published.
rates.h.locked_fixed: Fixed: this contract's versions were priced and sold on it.
rates.h.locked_versioned: Set per version: change it in a draft version and publish it.
rates.h.manual_rate: 1 unit of the source currency = this many units of the target currency.
rates.h.market: Guests of this market are sold this contract. Never assigned silently.
rates.h.markup_label: Name shown in price explanations, e.g. “DACH direct +8 %”.
rates.h.markup_priority: Only breaks ties between rules with exactly the same scope.
rates.h.max_age_days: Refuse to convert with a provider rate older than this.
rates.h.max_lead_days: Booked at most this many days before arrival (0 = no limit).
rates.h.member_only: Not available yet: no sale identifies a member, so a members-only promotion would never apply. Untick it and send your members a promotion code instead.
rates.h.min_basket: The amount the booking must reach, in the promotion's currency, before the promotion applies: accommodation before discounts plus extras, of the booking's rooms it applies to, together.
rates.h.min_lead_days: Booked at least this many days before arrival (early booking).
rates.h.offer_code: Unique within the contract, e.g. EB15.
rates.h.per_guest_limit: How often one guest may use it (0 = unlimited).
rates.h.period_code: Short code referenced by prices and rules, e.g. HIGH27.
rates.h.period_priority: When periods overlap (e.g. a weekend period inside high season), the higher priority wins.
rates.h.plan_op: Rate plan price relative to the contract price, e.g. −12 % for non-refundable.
rates.h.preview_currency: Converting needs an FX policy for the pair.
rates.h.preview_market: Changes which markup and promotions apply; the contract stays the same.
rates.h.prices_include_tax: If on, taxes are extracted from the prices instead of being added.
rates.h.pricing_basis: Per person: a base person rate × occupancy rules. Per room: one price per room per night.
rates.h.offer_group: Offers in the same group never combine. The one with the highest priority is applied; on equal priority the offer whose code comes first alphabetically (EB15 before LS7), not the better offer or the one entered first. If the top one is refused by the stacking rules, the group stays open and the next one in it can apply.
rates.h.promo_group: Promotions in the same group never combine. The one with the highest priority is applied; on equal priority the older promotion (the lower ID), not the better offer. If the top one is refused by the stacking rules (not stackable while another promotion applies), the group stays open and the next one in it can apply.
rates.h.property_global: Leave empty to apply to every hotel you manage.
rates.h.property_hotel: The hotel this record belongs to.
rates.h.refundable: Non-refundable policies charge 100 % on any cancellation.
rates.h.row_refundable: Refundable only if the rate plan and its cancellation policy both are. Choosing a rate plan or a policy sets it; a refundable row on a non-refundable policy cannot be published.
rates.h.release_days: Unsold rooms go back to general sale this many days before arrival.
rates.h.requires_extras: Extra codes that must be booked too, comma separated (package deals).
rates.h.room_basis_children_fill_include: E.g. 1 adult + 1 child in a room priced for 2: the child takes the free place.
rates.h.sale_at: Price as if booked at this moment (versions, promotions and markup in force then). Empty = now.
rates.h.sale_vs_stay: Sale dates limit when the booking is made; stay dates limit the nights of the stay.
rates.h.sell_currency: Currency shown to guests; empty = contract currency.
rates.h.stackable: May combine with other stackable promotions.
rates.h.stacking.ADDITIVE: Percentages are added up and taken from the price before promotions.
rates.h.stacking.SEQUENTIAL: Each promotion is taken from the price left after the previous one.
rates.h.stacking_rules: Exclusive beats everything; promotions of the same incompatible group never combine; otherwise stackable ones combine in priority order.
rates.h.tax_currency: Per person or per room night levies are charged in this currency and converted at the exchange rate of the sale time.
rates.h.to_age: Exclusive: 2.99 and 3 both mean “until the 3rd birthday”.
rates.h.usage_limit: Total redemptions across all guests (0 = unlimited).
rates.h.value_added: What the guest gets, e.g. “Free airport transfer”.
rates.h.weekdays: Only these weekdays belong to the period. None selected = every day.
rates.markup_help.ADD: Selling price = contract price + a fixed amount per night.
rates.markup_help.ADJUST_PERCENT: Selling price = contract price + x %, e.g. 8 turns 1,000 into 1,080.
rates.markup_help.MULTIPLY: Selling price = contract price × value, e.g. 1.08.
rates.nav.label: Selling rules sections
rates.occ.empty: No own rules: every adult pays the full base rate and children follow the pricing policy.
rates.occ.intro.PERSON: Per-person pricing: each occupant is a slot priced from the base person rate. Example: adults 1–2 × 1.00, adult 3 × 0.70; child 7–12 pays 50 %.
rates.occ.intro.ROOM: Per-room pricing: the room price covers the included adults. Extra adults and children are priced with these rules; single use is a combination rule (e.g. 1+0 × 0.80).
rates.occ.no_bands: No child age bands in this version — child rules use the bands of the pricing policy.
rates.occ.precedence: A rule of this version beats every pricing-policy rule (hotel + market > market > hotel > global); then override > combination > period > room > the rest. An infant is priced by a rule naming its age band before any other. A rule set to “Inherit” passes to the next one; two equal rules with different values block publishing.
rates.offers.intro: Offers written into the contract itself (e.g. the hotel's early-booking discount). They are frozen with the version. Hotel-wide campaigns belong in Promotions.
rates.op_help.ABSOLUTE: The price per night is exactly this amount (e.g. 95.00).
rates.op_help.ADD: Base price plus a fixed amount.
rates.op_help.ADJUST_PERCENT: Base price plus or minus a percentage, e.g. 10 or −15.
rates.op_help.FIXED: A fixed amount for this slot, whatever the base price.
rates.op_help.INHERIT: No own value here: the next, less specific rule applies.
rates.op_help.MULTIPLY: Base price × value, e.g. 1.35 for a room 35 % above the base room.
rates.op_help.PERCENT_OF: A share of the base price, e.g. 50 = pays half.
rates.op_help.SUBTRACT: Base price minus a fixed amount.
rates.periods.empty: No periods yet. Add the stay periods of the season.
rates.periods.intro: Stay periods split the season (e.g. Low, Shoulder, High). Weekday periods (e.g. Fri–Sat) can sit inside a season with a higher priority.
rates.plans.empty: No rate plans: the contract sells one standard rate.
rates.plans.intro: Rate plans sold under this contract, priced relative to the contract price (e.g. non-refundable −12 %), with their own cancellation and payment terms.
rates.policy.activate_at: At a scheduled date and time
rates.policy.activate_body: It starts applying to new quotes and bookings; the previous live revision is superseded. Existing reservations keep their prices.
rates.policy.allotments.help: The contract can sell at most this many rooms per night until the release date; guaranteed allotments are withheld from everyone else. After the release it sells from general sale until its cutoff.
rates.policy.allotments.intro: Rooms reserved for a contract per night, returned to general sale at release.
rates.policy.allotments.title: Allotments
rates.policy.archive_body: It stops applying to new quotes and bookings now. Existing reservations keep their prices. This is recorded in the audit trail.
rates.policy.archived_body: It no longer applies to new quotes and bookings, and it cannot be edited. Past reservations keep the prices it produced.
rates.policy.cancellation.intro: Penalties by days before arrival, linked to rate plans.
rates.policy.cancellation.rules_help: Each row: cancelling fewer than N days before arrival costs its penalty. When several rows apply, the one with the smallest N (closest to arrival) is charged.
rates.policy.cancellation.title: Cancellation policies
rates.policy.delete_body: The record is deleted. This fails if it is still used, e.g. by a rate plan.
rates.policy.delete_draft_body: The draft revision is removed. Live revisions are not affected.
rates.policy.draft_body: Draft: not applied to any price until you activate it.
rates.policy.extras.intro: Transfers, dining, spa, celebrations and other services guests can add during or after booking.
rates.policy.extras.pricing_help: Choose how the price is multiplied: per booking, room, person, night, unit…
rates.policy.extras.rules_help: Optional prices that vary by market, room, channel or dates. The most specific matching row wins.
rates.policy.extras.title: Extras
rates.policy.fx.conversion_help: A rate always reads: 1 unit of the source currency = rate × target currency.
rates.policy.fx.intro: How selling prices are converted between currencies. Money is never converted without an explicit policy.
rates.policy.fx.title: FX policies
rates.policy.history_hint: All revisions of this record. Prices of past bookings were calculated with the revision live at the time.
rates.policy.live_body: Live records are immutable so that past prices stay explainable. Click “Revise” to create an editable draft revision.
rates.policy.live_title: This revision is live and cannot be edited
rates.policy.markup.intro: Markup turns the contract (net) price into the selling price, e.g. 1,000 + 8 % = 1,080. The most specific matching rule wins.
rates.policy.markup.scope_help: Leave a field empty to apply everywhere. Specificity (lowest to highest): hotel, market, contract, room, stay dates, channel.
rates.policy.markup.title: Markup rules
rates.policy.no_permission: You can view this record but not change it.
rates.policy.payment.intro: What the guest pays at booking and when the balance is due.
rates.policy.payment.title: Payment policies
rates.policy.pricing.intro: Default child age bands and occupancy rules. When a contract is published, every matching live policy cascades into it: policy rules price the slots the contract's own rules leave open, and policy age bands are used only when the contract has none of its own.
rates.policy.pricing.occ_help: Default adult/child rules, overridden by any rule in a contract version.
rates.policy.pricing.override_help: Beats the other rules of this policy for the same slot. A rule of the contract itself or of a more specific policy still wins, and so does a rule naming an infant's age band.
rates.policy.pricing.scope_help: Every live policy that matches a contract applies when the contract is published: hotel + market over market over hotel over global. Age bands come from the most specific policy that defines them. One live policy per hotel and market; change it with a new revision.
rates.policy.pricing.title: Pricing policies
rates.policy.promotions.eligibility_help: Leave a list empty to allow everything.
rates.policy.promotions.group_tie: {name} ({id}) is in the same group with the same priority, and their dates meet: only the older promotion, {older}, is applied. Give one a higher priority to choose.
rates.policy.promotions.intro: Early booking, last minute, long stay, member and coupon discounts across contracts. Each result explains why a promotion did or did not apply.
rates.policy.promotions.title: Promotions & discounts
rates.policy.revision_hint: Live records never change: “Revise” creates a new draft revision that replaces the live one when you activate it. History shows every revision.
rates.policy.superseded_body: A newer revision is live. This one stays read-only so past prices remain explainable; “Revise” starts a new draft from it.
rates.policy.taxes.intro: The hotel's taxes. A change is a new revision from its activation: stays already sold keep the taxes of their sale time.
rates.policy.taxes.rules_help: One row per tax. A percentage applies to the chosen part of the stay; per person or per room night levies are fixed amounts in the policy's currency, charged on the stay.
rates.policy.taxes.title: Taxes
rates.preview.calculator_hint: Room, board, dates and guests — the server prices the stay and explains it.
rates.preview.intro: Price a stay on this version exactly as the booking engine would, and see which rule won at every step.
rates.preview.matrix_hint: Nightly unit per room and period.
rates.preview.needs_cost: The price check shows contract cost and margin, so it needs the “View contract cost” permission.
rates.preview.nightly_hint: Unit, occupancy, board and cost in {contract}; selling prices in {sell}.
rates.preview.no_plans: This contract has no rate plans.
rates.preview.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. The price check uses the saved draft.
rates.preview.why_hint: Every step names the rule and the level that won.
rates.promo_value_help.FIXED_NIGHT: A fixed amount off each eligible night.
rates.promo_value_help.FIXED_STAY: A fixed amount off once per room and stay.
rates.promo_value_help.FREE_NIGHTS: The cheapest nights are free, e.g. stay 7 pay 6.
rates.promo_value_help.VALUE_ADDED: No price change; the guest gets an inclusion.
rates.rates.caption: Room prices by period
rates.rates.intro: Set the base room's price per period, then derive other rooms (e.g. Superior × 1.15 of Standard). A price set for a single period overrides the “All periods” rule. Click a cell to edit.
rates.rates.orphans: Prices for unknown rooms or periods
rates.rates.orphans_hint: These rules refer to a room or period that is no longer in this version. Delete or fix them.
rates.rates.resolved_after_save: Save the draft to see the resulting prices.
rates.rates.resolved_legend: Green figures are the resulting nightly prices calculated by the server for the saved version.
rates.rooms.capacity: Sells up to {adults} adults, {children} children, {total} people in total.
rates.rooms.empty: No rooms yet. Add the room types this contract sells.
rates.rooms.intro: Room types sold under this contract. Mark one base room: its prices are set per period and the others can follow it.
rates.rooms.many_base: More than one base room is marked. Usually there is exactly one.
rates.rooms.no_base: No base room is marked. Derived prices need a base room.
rates.selling.edit_in_header: Change them with Edit header on the contract page. After the first publish each new version carries its own.
rates.selling.from_header: Until the contract's first publish these come from the contract header.
rates.selling.frozen: Frozen with this version: bookings made while it was live were sold on these terms.
rates.selling.intro_version: When, where and in which order this version sells. They are frozen with the version when it is published; the contract then shows the live version's.
rates.selling.legacy: Frozen before selling terms were versioned: it sells only where both its frozen terms and the contract header it had at the upgrade allow. Publish a new version to change that.
rates.selling.legacy_market: The header's market {market} also still applies.
rates.selling.title: Selling terms
rates.settings.intro: How the engine reads this version. These settings are frozen with the version when it is published.
rates.stage_help.COST: Reduces the contract cost before markup (e.g. a hotel early-booking on net rates).
rates.stage_help.SELL: Taken from the selling price after markup and FX (guest-facing discount).
rates.stay_match_help.ALL_NIGHTS: Applies only if every night is inside the stay dates.
rates.stay_match_help.ANY_NIGHT: Only the nights that fall inside the stay dates get the discount.
rates.stay_match_help.ARRIVAL: If the guest arrives inside the stay dates, the whole stay gets it.
rates.stay_match_help.DEPARTURE: If the guest departs inside the stay dates, the whole stay gets it.
rates.trigger_help.Automatic: Applies to every eligible booking without a code.
rates.trigger_help.Code: Applies only when the coupon code is entered.
rates.v.fix_required: Fill in the required fields first.
rates.v.not_allowed: Not available with the other choices on this form.
rates.v.range: The end date is before the start date.

rates.version.ack_warnings.one: I have reviewed the warning and want to publish anyway
rates.version.ack_warnings.other: I have reviewed the {count} warnings and want to publish anyway

rates.version.check_ok: No errors or warnings. The version can be published.
rates.version.draft_exists: This contract already has a draft. Publish or edit it first.
rates.version.effective_later: At a later date and time
rates.version.first_draft: This will be the contract's first version.
rates.version.fix_errors: Fix the errors in the draft before publishing.
rates.version.immutable_body: These prices are frozen: reservations sold on this version are always priced from it. To change prices, create a new draft from this version, edit it and publish it.
rates.version.new_draft_desc: A draft is your working copy. Edit prices freely; nothing is sold until you publish it.
rates.version.new_draft_from_this: Create new draft from this version
rates.version.no_edit_permission: You can view this draft but not edit it (contract.edit is needed).
rates.version.publish_desc: The server checks the version, freezes its prices and puts it on sale.
rates.version.publish_notice: From that moment new bookings use this version. Reservations already sold keep their original prices; the previous version stops selling.
rates.version.save_failed: The draft could not be saved
rates.version.draft_changed: This draft was changed after you opened it. Your save was not applied: reload the draft to see the change, then make your edit again.
rates.version.timeline_hint: Every price change is a new version. Published versions never change; reservations keep the version they were sold on.
rates.version.withdraw_body: New bookings stop using this version immediately. Existing reservations keep their prices. If no other version is live, the contract stops selling.
rates.version.withdraw_body_scheduled: This version has not started selling. Withdrawing it cancels it: the version selling now keeps selling until the next published version starts (or with no end). Existing reservations keep their prices.
rates.lists.truncated: Only the first rows are shown. Narrow the list with the filters.
rates.lists.which_current_hint: From the versions that sell now or later and from drafts, of contracts that are not archived. Superseded and withdrawn versions, and archived contracts, are under All versions.
rates.lists.which_all_hint: From every version, including superseded and withdrawn ones: reservations sold on them keep these terms.
rates.lists.versions.subtitle: Every version of every contract: what sells now, what is scheduled, drafts and history.
rates.lists.periods.subtitle: Price periods of every contract, with their dates, weekdays and night adjustment.
rates.lists.occupancy.subtitle: Occupancy rules of every contract: extra adults, children by age band and room combinations.
rates.lists.rate_plans.subtitle: The rate plans each contract sells, with refundability, boards and policies.
rates.lists.restrictions.subtitle: Stop sell, minimum and maximum stay, arrival and departure closures, release and booking windows, by room type and scope.
rates.lists.restrictions.caption: Restrictions from {from} to {to}
rates.lists.restrictions.none_hint: Restrictions are set in the rates & availability grid.
rates.lists.restrictions.open_hint: Select a row to open the rates & availability grid on its first day.
rates.lists.restrictions.range_order: The end date is before the start date.
rates.lists.restrictions.range_max: Choose a period of at most a year.
rates.rules.intro: Rate plans and version settings, then every table of the version as rows: weekdays, priorities, notes and raw rules included.
rates.ws.base_occ.label: Base occupancy
rates.ws.base_occ.title: Adults included in the price of {room}
